correctness.rationale: The parameter inequalities exactly characterize a metric. Symmetry averaging is norm nonincreasing for unrestricted signed operators. Explicit 0-1 Lipschitz source functions force the four lower bounds. Choosing c as their maximum and a=max{1/(2m),1-rc}, b=1/m-a produces nonnegative coefficients and meets every source-new and new-new inequality on the full real parameter domain. The finite Lipschitz-free universal property proves equality to Banach-valued and projection constants. The exact checker reproduced 118 rational parameter settings and 766160 pair inequalities, separately from the analytic proof.

value.rationale: A complete, natural four-parameter (one integer, three real) family of equilateral-source two-centre free-space projections has an exact sharp constant, attained by one positive operator against all signed competitors. The inter-centre term creates a strict coupling cost not visible in one-centre theory; it and the near-block term yield explicit transition surfaces and support saturation. This is a structural infinite-family classification rather than an arbitrary slice or table.
